labs.lab_name: Center for Innovation in Social Work & Health
labs.research_summary: Works to improve community health by bringing social work, public health and medicine together on prevention and intervention strategies for urban health care.
labs.notes: Listed on School of Social Work's Centers & Institutes page; not read further. List also links the name to http://www.bu.edu/ciswh/.

labs.lab_name: Center for Aging & Disability Education & Research (CADER)
labs.research_summary: Strengthens the workforce that serves older adults and people with disabilities through online, competency-based training.
labs.notes: Listed on School of Social Work's Centers & Institutes page; not read further. Website is the 'Visit the CADER Site' link; the name itself links to https://caderonline.bu.edu/cader/.

labs.lab_name: Institute for Equity in Child Opportunity & Healthy Development (IECOHD)
labs.pi_title: Professor of social work; leads the Institute
labs.research_summary: Researches the conditions children need to thrive and tracks equity in child health, housing and early education using policy and data.
labs.notes: Listed on School of Social Work's Centers & Institutes page; not read further.
